title: Defects in skein theory and TQFT
summary: Given a 3-manifold $M$ with a network of line and point defects in its boundary, we define the skein module of this configuration, generalizing the well-studied case of 3-manifolds which only admit point defects in the boundary. We prove that when all defects are labelled by semisimple data, our skein module is isomorphic to the state space of $\partial M$ in the defect version of the Reshetikhin-Turaev TQFT constructed by Carqueville-Runkel-Schaumann.
